changes: Frame actual command output for pattern/idle matching; ignore command echo and whitespace-only output for idle arming.
Emit current-command/alternate-screen live preview rather than entire terminal history.
Expand exact pinned C-style stdin escapes while preserving unknown escapes.
Encode a complete watcher script as one command; preserve explicit/native exit codes and capture final PowerShell statement failure inside the block before call-operator status resets.
Provide a basic Console.ReadLine boundary wrapper when PSReadLine is unavailable, retaining post-echo OSC C framing for managed commands/raw stdin/polls.
Use bounded UTF-16LE base64 for watcher source: full65536 UTF-16-unit limit plus trailer/wrapper fits the256KiB input queue even for CJK/surrogate pairs.

nativeCorrections: Pinned PSReadLine-only C framing does not supply a no-module start marker; native basic read-line wrapper closes this tested fallback gap.
Pinned watcher wrapper also checks $? after expressions/call return; native captures the final statement inside the scriptblock to avoid false success.
UTF16LE in-memory encoding differs from pinned temporary script file; tested full source-size bound and Unicode, with no staging-file cleanup authority.
limits: Root coherent rebuild/full gate pending; this is not full POSIX or all-shell parity.

No claim that every earlier handled PowerShell error makes a watcher fail: last statement status is captured and existing nonzero native LASTEXITCODE precedence remains. Explicit exit wins.
The basic no-PSReadLine fallback has no advanced editing/completion features.
